selection_basis: independent EML metadata only; no response-bearing CSV was requested

counts.reason: EML schema has species and NumInd but no site or event key

fielddata.reason: joinable but lacks the standardized exclusion/no-observation fields available in R1

R1.reason: independently documented joined analysis-ready schema with exact site, event, year, species and exclusion fields

authoritative_response.immutable_identity: NPS Reference 2317363 + DownloadFile 757402 + frozen EML SHA256
authoritative_response.live_transport_preflight: HEAD only; no GET and no Range request

header_rule: The fetched CSV header must equal the 60-column EML order above exactly after UTF-8 BOM removal only; no alias, reordering, spelling repair or dropped/extra column is permitted after response access.

join_semantics.site_join_rule: exact trimmed string equality; any alternative alias or normalization discovered after response is forbidden
join_semantics.event_join_rule: both must parse as finite integer-valued numbers and compare as integers; no alternative event-key discovery after response
join_semantics.year_rule: EventYear must yield exactly one four-digit year in 2007-2019 and equal the matched nonresponse visit EventDate year

binary_flag_semantics.event_ExcludeEvent_rule: collect all nonmissing ExcludeEvent flags for the matched event; event is eligible iff at least one flag is present and every present flag equals 0; any 1 or all-missing excludes the event
binary_flag_semantics.missing_Incidental: exclude that observation from positive evidence
binary_flag_semantics.missing_ExcludeObservation: exclude that observation from positive evidence
binary_flag_semantics.missing_NoObservations: allowed because absence is derived from the eligible visit universe rather than an explicit zero row

site_year_algebra.eligible_event: a frozen forest-visits Event_ID in 2007-2019, at a finite-coordinate Point_Name, exact-joined to R1 and satisfying the conservative event ExcludeEvent rule
site_year_algebra.eligible_site_year: Point_Name x EventDate-year with at least one eligible event
site_year_algebra.target_positive_event: eligible event containing at least one R1 row with ScientificName exactly 'Melanerpes carolinus', ExcludeObservation exactly 0 and Incidental exactly 0; BirdCount magnitude is not required for binary presence
site_year_algebra.target_positive_site_year: eligible site-year with at least one target-positive event
site_year_algebra.target_negative_site_year: eligible site-year with zero target-positive events
site_year_algebra.no_eligible_event: excluded from modeling, never coded as negative
site_year_algebra.duplicate_target_rows: collapse to one binary positive at event and site-year levels
site_year_algebra.BirdCount_missing: does not negate an otherwise exact species detection because EML documents BirdCount may be permanently missing or not collected

integrity_stops_after_single_response_fe: response PointCode cannot exact-join to the frozen finite-coordinate registry for analyzable rows
EventID cannot be reconciled to the frozen visits registry under the frozen integer rule
binary exclusion flag contains an unexpected nonmissing token
frozen 30/30 estimability minima fail in any selection or outer partition
